messages:
maya: Heads up — we need to re-run next week's cross-functional roadmap sync. Two conflicting priority asks landed this morning (batching RFC vs infra cost spike). Need to lock agenda + owners. Who's available Mon/Tue? I'm proposing Mon 11:00am PT (45m) but can shift to Tue morning if folks need more time. Also we need a decision-log owner and someone to capture RFC action items.
sam: Mon 11am PT works for me. Can we add 10m for 'urgent infra cost prio'? I can present numbers.
adrian: Prefer Tue morning — Tue 9:00am PT would give us enough time for the batching RFC deep dive. If we do Tue I'd vote for 60m. @maya can we split into 60m if needed?
lee: I can do Mon but only after 11:30. If we start at 11:00 I might miss first ~15m.
olivia: +1 for Tue 9am PT. If we need longer I'd rather we keep to 45m and have follow-up breakouts for deep dives.
maya: Quick poll: react :one: for Mon 11am PT (45m) or :two: for Tue 9am PT (60m). Also proposing an agenda draft below — add owners or suggest changes. Poll closes EOD today.
calendar-bot: Provisional event created: "Crossfunc Roadmap Sync (provisional)" — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/xyz-abc — no confirmed time until poll closes.
jen: I can own decision-log capture and action items table if that helps.
adrian: :two: — also pinging @sam and @lee to prepare 5-slide bullets for the RFC and infra ask so we can stay time-boxed.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll prep infra numbers (cost delta + perf tradeoffs) and a 1-slide TL;DR.
lee: I'll own rollout risk & mitigations section.
maya: Agenda draft (please paste into event description if you're owning a part):
```
1) 10m Roadmap highlights (maya) — include 3m product-legal flag for data residency (olivia)
2) 20m RFC review: continuous batching (adrian)
3) 10m Infra cost / prioritization (sam)
4) 10m Rollout risk & mitigations (lee)
5) 5m Decision log + next steps (jen)
```
If you'd like changes, reply here. @jen can you add the decision log template to the event (owner, decision, options considered, tentative next steps)?
jen: On it — will add doc link + action-items table to the event description and create a short template for decisions.
olivia: FYI product-legal asked for a 3m flag re: data residency for the new routing policy. Can we include that under roadmap highlights as a micro-item?
maya: Noted and added. Also flagging cross-team invites: infra, platform, legal. @calendar-bot can you invite infra-team + platform-team + legal-team to the provisional event?
calendar-bot: Invites sent to infra-team, platform-team, legal-team (RSVPs pending). Event remains provisional until poll closes.
maya: Thanks all. Closing the poll at 6:00pm PT today. If there's no clear majority, default to Tue 9:00am PT (60m) so we have room for RFC. I'll update the calendar after poll results and copy the agenda + doc links into the event description. Ping me if you need a different slot.
